verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint: you set base_url to https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and api_key to your DeepInfra token. Its own docs also require setting `model` to a model from the DeepInfra catalog, so the story's 'change only the base URL and API key' does not strictly hold. missing for 10: no-model-change compatibility (the model parameter must also be changed), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK compatibility, documentation of which OpenAI SDK endpoints and parameters are supported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Set `model` to a model from our catalog
Drop-in OpenAI replacement. Point your existing OpenAI SDK to https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and your code works without changes.
